debt.text: Rivas says protecting Social Security and Medicare is a core commitment of her candidacy.
debt.quote: I will fight to make sure every family has economic opportunity, protect Social Security and Medicare, and reduce the threat of climate change.

immigration.text: Announced that she would vote against fiscal year 2026 funding for DHS and ICE, citing opposition to raids, detention and deportation efforts.
immigration.quote: I plan to proudly cast my NO vote to stand up for my community and immigrants.

guns.text: Rivas supports banning assault weapons and expanding background checks to all firearm and ammunition purchases.
guns.quote: legislation banning assault weapons, expanding background checks to all firearm and ammunition purchases, and blocking abusive dating partners from obtaining weapons

abortion.text: Rivas voted against the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act and against a bill restricting abortion coverage, earning a 100 score from Reproductive Freedom for All.
abortion.quote: A bill to ban abortion coverage in certain health plans and to raise health care costs.

health.text: Voted against the House-passed One Big Beautiful Bill Act, which the scorecard says would cut Medicaid funding and disqualify Planned Parenthood from the program.
health.quote: A bill to drastically cut Medicaid funding and disqualify Planned Parenthood from participating in the program for one year.

energy.text: Rivas names reducing the threat of climate change as a central goal and has authored climate legislation.
energy.quote: I will fight to make sure every family has economic opportunity, protect Social Security and Medicare, and reduce the threat of climate change.

voting.text: Criticized the SAVE Act for restricting voting access through documentary citizenship requirements and by eliminating mail-in and online voter registration methods.
voting.quote: The SAVE Act would restrict millions of Americans’ ability to vote by requiring voters to provide documentary proof of citizenship (DPOC);

tax.text: She calls for closing tax loopholes used by billionaires and lifting the Social Security income cap so the wealthy pay more, to fund programs like Medicare for All and tuition-free college.
tax.quote: Billionaires borrow against stock to avoid income taxes. Any loan backed by stock should be treated and taxed as income, just like wages.

wages.text: She supports raising the minimum wage to a living wage and strengthening unions and collective bargaining.
wages.quote: Protect the right to unionize, raise the minimum wage to a living wage, defend collective bargaining, and guarantee fair pay, safe workplaces, and strong labor protections for all workers.

debt.text: She pledges to protect Social Security and oppose benefit cuts or raising the retirement age.
debt.quote: We will protect Social Security, oppose benefit cuts or raising the retirement age, and lift the income cap so the wealthy pay their fair share.

schools.text: She advocates for stronger public schools and protecting them from privatization.
schools.quote: We advocate for stronger public schools, better teacher support, improved classrooms, protection from privatization, and universal pre-K and Head Start programs

safety.text: She calls for demilitarizing police, banning private prisons, ending mandatory minimums, and reforming use-of-force laws.
safety.quote: Championing criminal justice reform: demilitarize police, boost accountability, end school-to-prison pipeline, ban private prisons, eliminate mandatory minimums, and reform use-of-force laws.

immigration.text: She champions legal status for all immigrants and DREAM Act citizenship, and calls for abolishing ICE and building a humane system.
immigration.quote: Advocating for inclusive immigration policies, we champion legal status for all, DREAM Act citizenship, work visa programs, healthcare access, and justice for asylum seekers.

guns.text: Said stronger gun control is needed to protect public safety.
guns.quote: More restrictive gun control is needed to protect public safety.

abortion.text: She supports protecting legal access to abortion and reproductive healthcare and bodily autonomy.
abortion.quote: Ensure access to abortion and reproductive healthcare, defend bodily autonomy, and protect every person's freedom to make their own medical decisions without government interference.

gender.text: Supported allowing people to use public restrooms, showers, and changing rooms based on gender identity.
gender.quote: People should be allowed to use public restrooms, showers, and changing rooms based on "gender identity."

health.text: She advocates for Medicare for All and a single-payer health care system.
health.quote: Advocating for Medicare for All, promoting a single-payer solution for reform to our current healthcare system.

energy.text: She pushes for a rapid transition to clean energy to cut emissions and create jobs.
energy.quote: Clean energy now to lower costs, create local jobs, and protect the health of our communities and future generations.

sources: luzforcongress.com · rivas.house.gov · giffords.org · reproductivefreedomforall.org · angelica4congress.com · ivoterguide.com
